name: ver02-g1r-lethal-riders
description: S6 VER-02 G1-R: five selected lethal-release paths on four single-link owners, on the accepted C3a product. A Constrictor Snake weapon-lethal maintain; B Constrictor Snake constrict-lethal after surviving the weapon damage; C Salamander constrict-lethal; D Crocodile later-round death roll lethal; E Barbed Devil later-round Impale lethal. Each case: a real hold from a real attack, one ordinary rider round, a disclosed fixture health setting (target Damage = HP - margin; the disposable target's native dying allowance released so Dead = Damage >= HP; B/C margin = establishing weapon maximum + 1 from a read-only RuleCalculateWeaponStats), then the decisive native round; the killing damage, its rider bracket, the native Dead transition and the release location are recorded; then cleanup, two quiet rounds, a fresh real grab, and two same-owner independent controls. Disclosed: holder BAB 100; target HP 100000 and escape stats -100; summon deadlines extended to 600 s; appear buffs removed; brains off; units woken; navmesh placement within 10.5 m of the summoner; pauses.
